name: Nightly TLS Certificate Expiry Check
description: Proactively scan all clusters for TLS certificates expiring within the next 30 days and create alerts for any findings. Prevents certificate expiry incidents before they impact production.

steps.name: Discover TLS Resources
steps.description: Find all TLS secrets, ingress resources, and admission webhook configurations across all clusters

steps.name: Extract Certificate Data
steps.description: Parse certificate data from Kubernetes secrets and webhook configurations

steps.name: Check Certificate Expiry Dates
steps.description: Decode certificates and check expiry dates using openssl

action.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

THRESHOLD_DAYS=30
EXPIRY_THRESHOLD=$(date -d "+${THRESHOLD_DAYS} days" +%s)

find_expiring_certs() {
  local namespace=$1
  local secret=$2
  local cert_data=$3
  
  # Decode and check expiry
  local expiry_date=$(echo "$cert_data" | base64 -d | openssl x509 -noout -enddate | cut -d= -f2)
  local expiry_epoch=$(date -d "$expiry_date" +%s)
  
  if [ $expiry_epoch -lt $EXPIRY_THRESHOLD ]; then
    local days_left=$(( ($expiry_epoch - $(date +%s)) / 86400 ))
    echo "ALERT: Certificate in $namespace/$secret expires in $days_left days (on $expiry_date)"
  fi
}

# Process all TLS secrets
kubectl get secrets --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '
  .items[] |
  select(.type == "kubernetes.io/tls") |
  [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name, .data."tls.crt"] |
  @tsv
' | while IFS=$'\t' read -r namespace name cert; do
  find_expiring_certs "$namespace" "$name" "$cert"
done

steps.name: Create Alerts for Expiring Certificates
steps.description: For each certificate expiring within 30 days, create a console alert with remediation guidance

action.title: TLS Certificate Expiring Soon
action.remediation: Rotate the certificate using cert-manager or manually update the secret. See documentation: https://console.kubestellar.io/docs/security/tls-rotation

steps.name: Mission Summary
steps.description: Generate a summary report of all findings across all clusters
